records.title: FY2021 10-K
records.text: From a market-platform perspective, Gaming revenue was up 41% from a year ago, reflecting higher sales across desktop and laptop GPUs for gaming, and game-console SOCs.

records.title: FY2021 10-K
records.text: Our Gaming and Data Center market platforms have benefited from stronger demand as people continue to work, learn, and play from home.

records.title: FY2021 10-K
records.text: The overall net effect on our gross margin from inventory provisions and sales of items previously written down was insignificant in fiscal years 2021 and 2020.

records.title: FY2021 10-K
records.text: Gross margin for fiscal year 2021 was up 30 basis points from a year ago, primarily driven by product mix with higher Data Center and lower Automotive revenue, partially offset by Mellanox acquisition-related charges.

records.title: FY2021 10-K
records.text: Income from operations for fiscal year 2021 was $4.53 billion, up 59% from a year earlier.
